scope: 26 individually reviewed stranded members; confirmed outer archives were not re-judged
analysis_method: Source execution-path review; ZIP local/central directory parsing; bounded raw-DEFLATE decoding; atomscan and cleave facts for every member. No payload was executed.

migration.preservation: Matchers, defaults, scope and criticality preserved; exact consumers updated. No ancestor directory selectors found. Callback traits retain their original IDs.

members.marker_note: Zip-Slip depth-01: traversal defacement payload
members.byte_and_execution_review: One stored ZIP entry has 1 parent path components and targets index.php. Both local and central directory names agree; its entire seven-byte body is hacked followed by newline. Vulnerable extraction writes a defacement outside the destination. No PHP code or command execution is present.

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP shell: add IP-aware 404 concealment coverage
members.byte_and_execution_review: IP allowlist rejects nonmatching REMOTE_ADDR with 404 and die. A session nonce and SHA1 password hash gate the command branch. POST command is assigned to $command, then passed to proc_open with stdout/stderr pipes; escaped output returns to the browser. Legacy PHP syntax requires an older PHP interpreter.

final_hostile_findings.desc: PHP command form with variable execution
IP-aware command webshell includes 404 response
Laudanum PHP request-command shell payload

members.marker_note: Laudanum WP shell: arbitrary POST command execution
members.byte_and_execution_review: The WordPress template includes ipcheck.php and uses if(true) around the command handler, bypassing the local session authentication gate. POST command reaches proc_open; output is added to session output. The included IP check and host deployment are prerequisites. No covert encoded payload is present.

final_hostile_findings.desc: PHP command form with variable execution
Laudanum PHP request-command shell payload

members.marker_note: WordPress plugin shell: request commands and self-protection
members.byte_and_execution_review: Unauthenticated REQUEST[$cmd] supplies $command to executeCommand, which uses ReflectionFunction(system), call_user_func_array/system, call_user_func/system, passthru or system. Top-level system calls remove write permission and attempt chattr +i on __FILE__. The intended reverse-shell branch is unreliable because $ip is not initialized before use as a request key, and it assumes descriptor 3 is its socket. Verdict relies on the working command-dispatch branch.

final_hostile_findings.desc: PHP request assignment with variable shell execution
Command webshell executes immutability and write-removal commands

members.marker_note: Laudanum ASP shell: add IP-aware 404 concealment coverage
members.byte_and_execution_review: After a fixed REMOTE_ADDR comparison, rejected requests receive 404 and terminate. Request.Form(cmd) becomes cmd, which WScript.Shell.Exec launches; StdOut.ReadAll is HTML-escaped into the response. Requires a Classic ASP host with WSH automation permitted.

final_hostile_findings.desc: ASP command form and WSH execution co-occur
IP-aware ASP command shell includes 404
Laudanum ASP request-command shell payload

members.marker_note: Laudanum JSP WAR: HTTP cmd reaches Runtime.exec
members.byte_and_execution_review: WAR contains only deployment metadata and cmd.jsp. JSP reads request.getParameter(cmd), directly passes the value to Runtime.getRuntime().exec, then reads and prints child stdout. Both WARs contain byte-identical JSP source; each ZIP container was separately inspected.

final_hostile_findings.desc: JSP runs the cmd request parameter
JSP directly executes an HTTP parameter
Looks for a common design pattern in webshells where a request attribute is passed as an argument to exec().

members.marker_note: zbxl ZIP bomb: overlapping entries expand to petabytes
members.byte_and_execution_review: ZIP64 records describe 190023 files and 4507981427706459 total uncompressed bytes from 45876952 physical bytes. First members have distinct local headers but compressed data ranges ending at the same offset, 34144784. Bounded raw-DEFLATE decoding confirms real streams embedding later local headers. Full extraction was not attempted. Cleave limits detailed member enumeration to 65536, so its summed expanded size understates the full central directory.

final_hostile_findings.desc: Archive declares extreme compression expansion
Archive declares petabyte-scale compression expansion

members.marker_note: Tiny C root shell: clarify existing-authority prerequisite
members.byte_and_execution_review: main requests setresuid(0,0,0), ignores failure, then system(/bin/sh). It preserves root in a shell only if the OS already grants root or CAP_SETUID authority, such as a root-owned setuid installation. No standalone privilege-escalation exploit or network behavior exists.

final_hostile_findings.desc: Unguarded root-ID shell payload requires authority
Minimal root-ID shell payload requires authority

members.marker_note: C root shell: clarify existing-authority prerequisite
members.byte_and_execution_review: main requests setuid(0) and setgid(0), ignores failures, then system(/bin/sh). Source comments describe compilation and setuid installation, but do not perform installation. The intended privileged-shell stub needs pre-existing authority.

final_hostile_findings.desc: Unguarded root-ID shell payload requires authority
Minimal root-ID shell payload requires authority

members.marker_note: C bash root shell: clarify existing-authority prerequisite
members.byte_and_execution_review: main requests setuid(0), ignores failure, then execl(/bin/bash,bash,NULL). No command restriction or authentication exists. Root authority depends on privileged installation; the source itself does not create it.

final_hostile_findings.desc: Unguarded root-ID shell payload requires authority
Minimal root-ID shell payload requires authority

members.marker_note: Laudanum WP reverse shell: preserve socket-to-shell relay coverage
members.byte_and_execution_review: POST ip and port select the destination, with private-IP/8888 defaults. Optional pcntl_fork and posix_setsid detach; chdir and umask change process state. fsockopen opens the outbound socket; proc_open launches uname/w/id and an interactive sh. stream_select and fread/fwrite bridge socket input to child stdin and child stdout/stderr back to the socket.

final_hostile_findings.desc: PHP shell relays socket and pipes
Pentestmonkey PHP outbound shell relay

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP reverse shell: relocate fork and wait capabilities
members.byte_and_execution_review: The standalone variant uses a fixed private IP and port. It optionally detaches, launches an interactive shell using proc_open, and explicitly relays both directions between the outbound fsockopen socket and process pipes. No encryption or encoded stage is present.

final_hostile_findings.desc: PHP shell relays socket and pipes
Pentestmonkey PHP outbound shell relay

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP shell: 404 concealment; payload has syntax error
members.byte_and_execution_review: This is the same IP/password-gated PHP command-shell implementation, with a changed project banner and users configuration. The $users = array(...) statement lacks its terminating semicolon before the next statement. It is a malformed attack payload and cannot execute as supplied; its intended POST-to-proc_open command path is still explicit source evidence.

members.marker_note: Laudanum hidden PHP shell: request selects callable and argument
members.byte_and_execution_review: extract($_REQUEST) uses the default overwrite mode to import attacker-named variables. The immediately following die($ctime($atime)) invokes the imported callable with the imported argument, for example system with an OS command. This is unrestricted dynamic request dispatch with no IP/authentication gate; the timestamp-like variable names do not access file timestamps.

final_hostile_findings.desc: Request import with unrestricted variable call
Request import with variable-call exit response
